full_judgment: 6. Appearing in support of the appeals, Mr. S. M. Huq, the learned Advocate contended that the suits were not maintainable in view of Sections on C. P. C. and 21 of the Public Demands Recovery Act. Next, he has submitted that it was not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the learned Subordinate Judge has not reversed the findings with proper reasonings and assessment of his own. Mr. Habibur Rahman Khan, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents has supported the findings arrived at by the learned Subordinate Judge.
